'''Mahouton Norbert Hounkonnou''' is a Beninese [[professor]], [[mathematician]], [[physicist]] and writer. He is professor of Mathematics and Physics at the [[University of Abomey-Calavi]], the president of the  Benin [[National Academy of Sciences]], Arts and Letters, and a member of the [[African Academy of Sciences]] and [[the World Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.aasciences.africa/fellow/hounkonnou-norbert-mahouton|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221201120143/https://www.aasciences.africa/fellow/hounkonnou-norbert-mahouton|archive-date=2022-12-01|publisher=The African academy of sciences and arts|title=Hounkonnou Norbert Mahouton|work=Directory}}</ref>
